name: Dmitri Mendeleev
summary: Dmitri Ivanovich Mendeleev was a Russian chemist known for formulating the periodic law and creating a version of the periodic table of elements.

facts.text: Dmitri Ivanovich Dmitri Mendeleev was a Russian chemist known for formulating the periodic law and creating a version of the periodic table of elements.

facts.text: Dmitri Mendeleev used the periodic law not only to correct the then-accepted properties of some known elements, such as the valence and atomic weight of uranium, but also to predict the properties of three elements that were yet to be discovered.
